hud.darkmusic.help: Drag the combined HUD to move it. Scroll to resize it in 10%% steps (50–300%%). Escape saves and returns. Reset restores the top-left position and 100%% scale.
tools.darkmusic.auto: Automatic: installed tools or system PATH
tools.darkmusic.paths_help: Optional executable override. Leave blank for automatic lookup. Escape saves changes and returns. Use Install / Update Tools for automatic setup.
tools.darkmusic.install_help: Install yt-dlp and Deno from their official GitHub releases, plus FFmpeg and FFprobe from eugeneware/ffmpeg-static. Download size varies by platform; allow up to 1 GB of temporary disk space. SHA-256 checksums and executable capabilities are verified. Clicking approves installation or updates; nothing installs at startup. Advanced Paths overrides are preserved.

download.darkmusic.range_help: Inclusive entry numbers, independent of search results. For the first N entries, enter 1 and N. Selected entries do not affect this range.

hud.darkmusic.master_help: Show the combined Now-Playing HUD during gameplay. This switch does not disable the spectrum in the music player. F1 and open menus hide the gameplay HUD.

hud.darkmusic.transparency_help: Adjust only the combined HUD background, including transparent padding around artwork. Artwork, text, progress and spectrum bars keep their original opacity.

reset.darkmusic.title: Reset DarkMusic?
reset.darkmusic.help: Restore DarkMusic defaults and remove its installed download tools, history, and caches. A confirmation is required. Media files and playlists are preserved.
reset.darkmusic.body:
Restore all DarkMusic settings, key binds, volume, speed, HUD layout and scale, and the default music folder. Playback and pending downloads will stop. Remove tools installed inside DarkMusic, recognized download records (including downloaded.txt), and caches.

All audio and video files, including downloaded music, stay untouched in their current folders. Playlists and their folder references are preserved. External tools and unrecognized files are preserved. Clearing download records allows the same videos to be downloaded again.
reset.darkmusic.retained: Defaults restored. Some unrecognized, linked, or inaccessible files were preserved; see the log.
confirm.darkmusic.delete_body: Delete the playlist “%s”? This removes only the playlist and its song references. Audio and video files stay untouched. This cannot be undone.
confirm.darkmusic.delete_help: Delete the selected playlist after confirmation. Media files are preserved.
